items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the instrument of another band member (Bobby Alexis) and does not mention Eddie Winston or any interaction with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. And do you remember the band on your first gig that you went on? Those guys, who they would have been?

Yeah, I can give you a pretty good idea. Probably Eddie Winston on clarinet. We had a guy by the name of Murphy, but I can't remember if that was his first name or his second name. He was a trombone player. Probably Larry Mohobarack on piano. And maybe Charlie Mays on guitar. And Sonny Gammond, Vaughn Gammond Jr. was the drummer. That's probably generally who it was. I don't remember if we had a bass player in those days. Bass fiddle was an awfully hard instrument to find. It wasn't that many people played. Bobby…
Bobby was a string bass player.
